CustomField.description: The type of complaint, as chosen on the public complaint form, or as confirmed by staff in Record Complaint. Holds one of the Public Complaint's Complaint Type values; it is text so the list of types is kept in one place, on Public Complaint. Set by the flows, not edited by hand.
